title: Wobbly!
text: Wobbly!. These are great to have around but if you use them outside or in any windy situation or uneven table, they WILL TUMBLE OVER. Still, I’m happy to have them. You can use a sharpie and write everyone’s name on them. You can wash and reuse them. But this specific glass isn’t heavy enough, flat enough, wide enough, on the bottom.
